finding.observed: Desktop session 'NP doctor' (engine 2.1.309, Remote Control on), 2026-10-31 2:26-2:28 AM EDT, after the #49 install. The np status entry showed briefly after the np:codex worker started, then disappeared for good; the footer showed only the model and permission controls, so a closed pane could not be reopened. /np doctor printed no desktop lines. The pane listed '1 delegate · 1 running · 0 done', labelled 'Codex' again after each tool step, and kept the running state at the top, out of view below a long conversation.
finding.cause: The status entry was cleared once renderNpMenu had returned its Select on the desktop surface (footer 'drawn'), and the flag never reset. Clearing requires that path, so the desktop app did call the SessionMode hook with surface desktop, yet nothing appeared in its footer: it does not paint a mod's tree there. The app logs record no render error, and Remote Control admitted no remote client in that window. The doctor took its surface from command.run's presentation.surface, absent in the desktop app, so it fell back to terminal.
